full.en: Bio BALANCE Supergreens 150g. A green blend of superfoods with ashwagandha which contributes to emotional balance and general wellbeing. Ingredients: Lucuma (pouteria lucuma)*, hemp (cannabis sativa) protein*, barley grass (hordeum vulgare)*, wheat (triticum aestivum) grass*, chlorella (chlorella vulgaris)*, maca (Lepidium meyenii)*, ashwagandha (withania somnifera)*, strawberry flavour. *organic. Usage: Mix 1 teaspoon (5 g) in 100 mL of water and mix well. Storage: Dry and cool place.
full.sl: – Bio BALANCE Supergreens 150 g. Zelena mešanica superživil z ašvagando, ki prispeva k čustvenemu ravnovesju in splošnemu dobremu počutju. Sestavine: lucuma (pouteria lucuma)*, konopljini (cannabis sativa) proteini*, jecmenova (hordeum vulgare) trava*, pšenicna (triticum aestivum) trava*, klorela (chlorella vulgaris)*, maca (Lepidium meyenii)*, ašvaganda (withania somnifera)*, aroma jagode. *ekološko. Način uporabe: vmešajte 1 čajno žlicko (5 g) v 100 mL vode in dobro premešajte. Shranjevanje: hranite v suhem in hladnem prostoru.
full.hr: - Bio BALANCE Supergreens 150 g. Zelena mješavina superhrane s ashwagandom koja doprinosi emocionalnoj ravnoteži i općem blagostanju. Sastojci: lucuma (pouteria lucuma)*, konoplja (cannabis sativa) protein*, ječmena trava (hordeum vulgare)*, pšenica (triticum aestivum) trava*, klorela (chlorella vulgaris)*, maca (Lepidium meyenii)*, ashwagandha (withania somnifera)*, okus jagode. *organski. Ingredienti: lucuma (pouteria lucuma)*, proteine di canapa (cannabis sativa)*, erba d’orzo (hordeum vulgare)*, erba di grano (triticum aestivum)*, clorella (chlorella vulgaris)*, maca (Lepidium meyenii)*, ashwagandha (withania somnifera)*, aroma di fragola. *biologico.
